questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设总体} X \sim F(x),\ E(X)=\mu,\ D(X)=\sigma^{2}, \text {已知}\sigma^{2}.\text {从总体} X \text {抽取容量} n \text {较大的样本} X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}.\text {对于假设检验} \\ H_{0}:\mu=\mu_{0}\Leftrightarrow H_{1}:\mu<\mu_{0}.\text {设显著水平为}\alpha,\text{则检验统计量是} \underline{\hspace{2em}} \text{，检验拒绝域}W=\underline{\hspace{2em}}。() \end{array}

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}U = \frac{\left(\overline{X} - \mu_{0}\right)}{\sigma} \sqrt{n}\,,\;\; W = \left\{ u < -u_{\alpha}\right\}\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{aligned}u = \frac{\left(\bar{x} - \mu_{0}\right)}{\sigma} \sqrt{n}\,,\;\; W = \left\{ u < -u_{\alpha}\right\}\end{aligned}

options.html: \begin{array}{l} { r } { u = \frac { \left( \overline { { x } } - \mu _ { 0 } \right) } { \sigma } \sqrt { n } \, , \; \; W = \left\{ \, | u | < u _ { \alpha } \right\} } \end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&H_0 \text{成立时，}\frac{\overline{x}-\mu_0}{\sigma \sqrt{n}} \text{近似服从}N(0,1) \text{分布，故用单正态总体方差已知时均值的检验。其过程如下：}\\&(1) \text{检验假设为}H_0; \mu=\mu_0;\ H_1; \mu>\mu_0.\\&(2) \text{当}H_0 \text{为真时，有}U=\frac{\overline{X}-\mu_0}{\sigma \sqrt{n}} \sim N(0,1) \text{，记}U \text{的样本计算值}u，\text{则拒绝域为} |u|>u_{a2}，\text{其中} u_{a2}\text{为标准正态分布的分位数}。\\&\text{另外}：\\&\text{右侧检验：}H_0; \mu \leq \mu_0;\ H_1; \mu>\mu_0.\ \text{此时拒绝域为}u>u_a.\\&\text{左侧检验：}H_0; \mu \geq \mu_0;\ H_1; \mu<\mu_0.\ \text{此时拒绝域为}u<-u_a.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{检验假设}H_{0}: \mu=8,H_{1}: \mu<8.\\&\text{由于}n=100,\text{所以}T=\frac{\bar{X}-\mu}{S\sqrt{n}}\text{近似服从}N(0,1)\text{分布},\alpha=0.05,u_{0.05}=1.645.\\&\text{又知}x=6.5,s=2,\text{故计算得}\\&\qquad t=\frac{6.5-8}{2\sqrt{100}}=-7.5,\\&\text{否定域}W=\left\{\frac{\bar{X}-8}{S\sqrt{n}}<-u_{0.05}\right\}.\\&\text{因为}-7.5<-1.645,\text{故否定}H_{0},\text{认为这位校长的看法是对的。}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{这是两个比率的比较问题，待检假设为}\\&H_0: p_1 = p_2,\; H_1: p_1 \neq p_2.\\&\text{由题设知}n=300,\;\mu_n=168,\;m=200,\;\mu_m=96,\\&\quad\widehat{p_1}=\frac{168}{320}=0.56,\;\widehat{p_2}=\frac{96}{200}=0.48,\\&\quad\widehat{p}=\frac{\mu_n+\mu_m}{m+n}=\frac{264}{500}=0.528.\\&\quad\widehat{U_0}=\frac{\widehat{p_1}-\widehat{p_2}}{\sqrt{p(1-\widehat{p})\left(\frac{1}{n}+\frac{1}{m}\right)}}=\frac{0.56-0.48}{\sqrt{0.528\times 0.472\times \frac{1}{120}}}\approx 1.755,\\&\text{由}P\{|\widehat{U}|>1.96\}=\alpha=0.05,\;\text{得拒绝域}\;\widehat{U}|>1.96,\;\text{因为}\\&\quad\widehat{U_0}=1.755<1.96,\;\text{故接受}H_0,\text{即两个选区之间无显著差异}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{这是属于大样本情形下两个总体分布未知、两个总体方差未知且相等的均值的差异性检验，提出假设：} \\ & \quad \quad \quad H_{0}: \mu_{1}=\mu_{2}, \quad H_{1}: \mu_{1}\neq \mu_{2}. \\ & \text{由于} \alpha=0.05, u_{n/2}=1.96, \text{又} \\ & \quad \quad n_{1}=n_{2}=100, \bar{x}=28, \bar{y}=26, s_{1}^{2}=35.8, s_{2}^{2}=32.3 \,, \\ & \text{计算统计量 } U \text{ 的值.} \\ & \quad \text{将上述数据代入计算统计量 } U \text{ 的观察值} \\ & \quad \quad u=\frac{\bar{x}-\bar{y}}{\sqrt{\frac{(n_{1}-1)s_{2}^{2}+(n_{2}-1)s_{1}^{2}}{n_{1}+n_{2}-2}}\sqrt{\frac{1}{n_{1}}+\frac{1}{n_{2}}}}=24.2 \, , \\ & \text{由于 } |u|>1.96, \text{ 故否定 } H_{0}, \text{ 在显著性水平 } \alpha=0.05 \text{ 下可认为两种小麦株高之间有显著差异.} \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{设该药品对某种疾病的治愈率为}p,\text{随机变量}X\text{为}\\&\quad X=\begin{cases}1,\quad\text{临床者使用该药品治愈}\\0,\quad\text{反之}\end{cases}\\&\text{则}X\sim b(1,p),\text{问题该归结为检验假设：}\\&\quad H_0: p=0.9,\;H_1: p\neq 0.9.\\&\text{由于}n=120\text{足够大，可以用}u\text{检验法，所给样值}(x_1,x_2,\cdots,x_{120})\text{中有}85\text{个}1，35\text{个}0，\text{所以}\\&\quad x=\frac{1}{120}\sum_{i=1}^{120}x_i=\frac{1}{120}\sum_{i=1}^{85}\frac{1}{120}\approx 0.71,\\&\text{又}p_0=0.9,\text{以之代入统计量}U\text{得}U\text{的观察值为}\\&\quad|u|=\frac{|0.71-0.9|}{\sqrt{120\times 0.9\times 0.1}}\sqrt{120}=6.94>u_{0.01}=2.33,\\&\text{故拒绝}H_0,\text{即认为该药品不真实。}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{设高速公路上的车速为随机变量}X,\text{近似有}\\&\quad X\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2),\sigma=13.4\text{km/h},\\&\text{要检验假设}\\&\quad H_0:\mu=\mu_0=104.6,H_1:\mu>104.6.\\&\quad\alpha=0.05,\,n=85,\,u_\alpha=u_{0.05}=1.645.\\&\text{拒绝域}W=\left\{u=\frac{\bar{x}-\mu_0}{\sigma\sqrt{n}}>u_\alpha\right\}.\\&\text{由}\bar{x}=106.7,\,\sigma=13.4,\,\mu_0=104.6,\,n=85\text{得}\\&\quad u=\frac{106.7-104.6}{13.4/\sqrt{85}}\approx 1.44<1.645.\\&\text{因为}1.44<1.645,\text{所以接受}H_0,\text{即要}\alpha=0.05\text{显著性水平下，没有明显的证据说明汽车行驶快于限制速度。}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设总体}X,Y \text{皆服从两点分布} \\ \begin{array}{|c|c|c|} \hline X & 0 & 1 \\ \hline p_{1} & p_{1} & q_{1} \\ \hline \end{array} \quad \begin{array}{|c|c|c|} \hline Y & 0 & 1 \\ \hline p_{1} & p_{2} & q_{2} \\ \hline \end{array} \\ (p_{1}+q_{1}=1, p_{2}+q_{2}=1,\text{且}0<p_{1}<1,0<p_{2}<1)\text{. 从总体} \lambda \text{取样本}X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n_{1}}\text{, 从总体}Y_{1},Y_{2},\cdots,Y_{n_{2}}\text{, 两样本独立. 对于假设检验} \\ H_{0}:p_{1}=p_{2} \Leftrightarrow H_{1}:p_{1}\neq p_{2} \\ \text{设显著水平为} \alpha\text{, 则检验统计量是（. （假设}n_{1},n_{2}\text{充分大）.} \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{令}A=\{X=1\},\ B=\{Y=1\},\ \text{则}X,Y\text{分别为}A,B\text{发生的频率，即}x=\frac{n_A}{n_1}=\widehat{p_1},\ y=\frac{n_B}{n_2}=\widehat{p_2}\text{，检验假设为}\\&H_0:p_1=p_2\leftrightarrow H_1:p_1\neq p_2,\ \\&\text{根据中心极限定理，当}H_0\text{真，且}n_1,n_2\text{充分大时，}\\&U=\frac{\overline{p_1}-\overline{p_2}}{\sqrt{\frac{-p_1}{n_1}-p_2}{(\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2})}}\text{近似服从}N(0,1),\\&\text{其中}p=\frac{n_A+n_B}{n_1+n_2}\text{．记}U\text{的样本观察值为}u\text{，则有拒绝域为}|u|>u_{0.2}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{由于 }n_1=1500,\;n_2=1800,\text{这是大样本情形下两个0-1总体的概率检验问题. 假设}\\ & \qquad\qquad H_0: p_1=p_2,\;H_1: p_1\neq p_2.\\ & \text{由于 }n_1=1500,\;n_2=1800,\;\mu_{n_1}=300,\;\mu_{n_2}=320,\text{经济计算得}\\ & \qquad\qquad \overline{P_1}=\frac{\mu_{n_1}}{n_1}=0.200,\;\; \overline{p_2}=\frac{\mu_{n_2}}{n_2}=0.178,\;\; \overline{P}=\frac{\mu_{n_1}+\mu_{n_2}}{n_1+n_2}=0.188,\\ & \qquad\qquad u=\frac{\overline{p_1}-\overline{p_2}}{\sqrt{p(1-p)(1/n_1+1/n_2)}}=1.61,\\ & \text{由 }\alpha=0.05,\text{可知}u_{n_2}=1.96,\text{由于 }|u|<u_{n_2},\text{故在显著性水平 }\alpha=0.05 \text{下接受} H_0.\end{aligned}
